recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'gofmt -w config/config.go config/config_test.go cmd/flipt/main.go internal/info/flipt.go telemetry/telemetry.go telemetry_repro_test.go
git diff --stat
GOPROXY=off go test ./config ./telemetry ./internal/info ./cmd/flipt ./ -count=1'

/bin/bash -lc "rm telemetry_repro_test.go
cat > internal/info/flipt_test.go <<'EOF'
package info

import (
 \"encoding/json\"
 \"net/http\"
 \"net/http/httptest\"
 \"testing\"
)

func TestFliptServeHTTP(t *testing.T) {
 w := httptest.NewRecorder()
 (Flipt{Version: \"1.2.3\"}).ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, \"/meta/info\", nil))
 if w.Code "'!= http.StatusOK { t.Fatalf("status = %d", w.Code) }
 var result Flipt
 if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if result.Version != "1.2.3" { t.Fatalf("version = %q", result.Version) }
}
EOF
python3 - <<'"'PY'
p='config/config_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('func TestTelemetryEnvironment(t *testing.T) {', 'func TestTelemetryEnvironment(t *testing.T) {\\n assert.True(t, Default().Meta.TelemetryEnabled)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w internal/info/flipt_test.go config/config_test.go
GOPROXY=off go test ./config ./telemetry ./internal/info ./cmd/flipt -count=1"

/bin/bash -lc 'gofmt -w telemetry/telemetry.go telemetry/telemetry_test.go
GOPROXY=off go test ./... -count=1
git diff --check'

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
